工位的一天(A Day at the work station): 围绕职场工作的A1短文:介绍本的日常、喜好与工位。
I like my life very much. The weekly report is big and clean. Lily often helps me with science. Best of all, a doctor's note backs the sick leave.
Ben's favorite season is autumn. The work station is my favorite place. After school, we play together. Also, I clean my office every Friday.
I am happy every day. Ben usually eats rice for lunch. The work station is not far from my home.
